 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Smallest atom:- **

 
 
• **atoms are made up** of three particles: **protons, neutrons and electrons** which are composed of even smaller particles, such as quarks.
 
• The name of the smallest atom among above is Lithium. Lithum is a chemical element with the **symbol Li **and **atomic number 3**.
 
 
 
• **Metalloid: **
 
 
• Metalloids can be defined as chemical elements whose **physical and chemical properties fall in between the metal and non-metal categories**. 
 
• **Boron, germanium, silicon, antimony, arsenic, tellurium and pollanium** are the seven most widely recognized metalloids.
 
 
 
• **most metallic natural element: **
 
 
• Metallic character of elements** increases down a group** and **decreases from left to right** across a period.
 
• The alkali metals in group 1 are the most metallic elements, and **caesium is the last element in the group**.
 
 
 
• **Electronegative: **
 
 
• The tendency of an atom in **a molecule to attract the shared pair of electrons** towards itself is known as electronegativity. 
 
• **Fluorine is the most electronegative element** on the periodic table. Its electronegativity value is 3.98.
 
• **Iodine is the least electronegative element**. Its electronegativity value is 0.79.
